description: Fast, native file search engine and launcher: name search, content search, and a daemon behind both (Zen 4+ tuned)
post_install: info 'rgy (Zen 4) READ THIS. Despite the name, searchctl is NOT a systemd service and does not require systemd.'
info '  It is a plain CLI. The daemon (searchd) is a separate, OPTIONAL binary.'
info '  Nothing installed here depends on the system init.'
info '  This is the Zen 4 build: its binaries are shimmed as *-znver4 and its shortcut is ''rgy (znver4)''.'
info '  rgxy (the launcher) needs a RUNNING daemon; without one it says ''no connection to the daemon''.'
info '  How do you want the search daemon enabled?'
info '    [1] Register it for the NEXT LOGON only (the install does not start it now).'
info '    [2] Register it AND start it NOW in this session. (default)'
info '    [Y] Accept the default - same as [2].'
info '  Note: registering alone never starts the daemon in the current session - HKCU Run'
info '  entries run at logon. And on its first start the daemon rebuilds the index of your'
info '  home directory before it opens its pipe, which can take a minute on a large tree;'
info '  rgxy will keep saying ''no connection to the daemon'' until that rebuild finishes.'
info '  Press 1, 2, N or Y to decide - no answer within 10 seconds keeps the default [2].'
info '  (no interactive console: keeping the default [2].)'
info '  (non-interactive install: no prompt. Using the default: register AND start the daemon now.)'
info '  Registering the daemon (no elevation, no dialog) ...'
info '  Registered through ''current'', so the next version bump keeps the daemon working.'
info '  Starting the daemon now (detached; it keeps running after this install) ...'
info '  It is indexing your home directory first; rgxy connects when the pipe opens.'
info '  Check progress with: rgy-autostart-znver4 doctor --name rgy-searchd-znver4'
info '  Registered. It will start at your NEXT LOGON, not now.'
info '  To start it sooner: rgy-autostart-znver4 doctor --name rgy-searchd-znver4'
info '  Undo it later with: rgy-autostart-znver4 uninstall --name rgy-searchd-znver4'
info '  No daemon installed. Two things to know:'
info '   - searchctl needs an INDEX, not a daemon. Index at least once:'

info '   - Try the launcher with nothing installed: Start-Process searchd.exe -ArgumentList ''--root'',$env:USERPROFILE,''--listen'',''pipe:rgy-try''; rgxy.exe --endpoint pipe:rgy-try --query invoice'
info '     Or just use searchctl-znver4 for one question. See the README for a daily index timer.'
